'''Etkis Rilad''' was a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Mos Eisley Police Authority|Mos Eisley Police]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TBDE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Etkis Rilad, piloting a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], was dispatched along with Officer [[Roris Zhaiss]] and several freelance pilots to defeat a group of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. The dreaded pirate leader only known as the [[Black Nemesis]] was killed in the battle.<ref name="SWG:TBDE" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Etkis Rilad appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBDE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Etkis Rilad was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:TBDE" />
